summary: AGM Group Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter dated October 9, 2026, stating its Class A ordinary shares closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days (August 27–October 8, 2026), breaching Nasdaq Rule 5550(a)(2). AGMH continues trading; the company has a 180-day compliance period ending April 7, 2027, with a potential second 180-day extension requiring minimum market value of publicly held shares and notice of intent to cure, including a possible reverse stock split. No advisor or board recommendation named. Watch for a reverse-split announcement and continued sub-$1 trading as the delisting clock runs.
